**Explanation:**
The key is to move your rook away from the attack while setting up an unstoppable back-rank mate. After Ra1, Black's rook or knight must capture on b5 (or Black falls behind in time). The lesson: when your king is trapped in the corner, look for forcing moves that exploit the lack of escape squares.
